items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: And when I met him, he was living with Bob Sylvester because he never had collected any money from him.

ctx.x: Back to Clayton Dorr, who was he playing with? Just spots? He didn't?

Oh, he played with some of the bands. Some of these bands that had a semi-name in those days are completely forgotten today. It was a band named Bob Sylvester that he played with. And when I met him, he was living with Bob Sylvester because he never had collected any money from him. And the only way he could collect any money from him was to live with him and deduct the lodging from what Sylvester owed him. And that was typical of the business in those days. And I guess the best he ever did was playing the stint…
What about George Horton? Was he playing trumpet there? He played trumpet.
